GROVES

Signal Night

Original songs.
A room of collected memories.

I’m building a live music performance you can walk through before and after the set.

Here’s the idea ↓
The project

The songs are the start.
GROVES is the room around them.

Forest projections. Recorded sounds. Objects and written memories you can stop and spend time with. In the middle of it, a live set of my original alternative R&B.

You can leave a memory of your own at the event, or just listen. I want people to hear something in this work that feels familiar to them.

How the night would feel

Before the set

Walk through the memory archive at your own pace. Read the fragments, look at the objects, and listen to the recorded sounds.

During the music

Live vocals, guitar, and arranged playback. Projections and lighting follow the emotional world of the songs.

After the last song

Spend more time with the installation. Leave an anonymous memory if you want to. The archive can grow with each audience.

This is the proposed event. The venue and date are still in development.

A note from me

Some things are easier
to say in a song.

Being there for my friend, then getting up to perform, changed how I thought about sharing my music. It made me think about what people are going through when they show up to a room like this.

That’s part of why I want to make GROVES. The music is personal, but I want there to be room for your memories, too.

Keenan / KYD

Making it happen

What the funding pays for

FEAST offers the chance to receive up to $2,000. Here’s what I’m asking it to help cover:

Sound & the room
Projection, lighting, and audio for the public performance.
The archive
Printed memory cards and materials visitors can explore.
Getting it there
Transportation and documentation of the work.

I’m designing the installation to travel, so the work can continue in more Oklahoma spaces after the first presentation.

The grant has not been awarded. Future venues and dates are still in development.
